name: structure-viewer
description: Read-only structure viewer with unchanged VASP filenames via a thread entrypoint and server-side path opening, depth-tested selection markers and geometry measurements.

interface.shortDescription: 原子结构与轨迹查看、选择与测量
interface.longDescription: Open POSCAR, CONTCAR and XDATCAR by their original paths through the Structure Viewer thread tab, locally or on the connected remote host. XYZ/extxyz/traj native file entrypoints, element visibility, box selection, measurements and snapshots are included.
